apps.notes: Billing by percent: set each payment's share and NodOne works out the amounts. Repeating tasks. ECC register, with the EMB clock. Reference: DENR memoranda and codes in one place. Two pages side by side. New look for Tasks and Checklist; one section open at a time in Records. Named versions for documents. Tasks linked to Gantt.

Tasks stay linked to NodOne. Client marks: extra work or delay asked by the client. Move several bars at once; selection bar with Delete and Move to group. Options in the toolbar; milestones show their date.

Every card shows a preview of the change; edit dates, days and percents before you approve. See on page: the change drawn on NodOne or Gantt before you approve. Knows unpaid invoices and billing. Works with the new ECC register, Reference, repeating tasks and the Gantt link.
Lot plotter shows the lot shape right away and keeps what you typed.
Downloads that get cut off now carry on from where they stopped.
